items.title: United (UAL) Unveils New Economy Plus Seating For Its Airbus A321XLR Fleet
items.summary: United Airlines Holdings (NasdaqGS:UAL) has introduced a new Economy Plus seating concept for its upcoming Airbus A321XLR fleet. The configuration includes extra elbow room and a shared table aimed at improving comfort on long international routes. United plans to be the first U.S. carrier to offer this specific Economy Plus option on the A321XLR.
